items.title: Top 3 Energy Stocks To Watch In November 2026
items.summary: Inflation keeps running hotter than expected, and the latest October consumer price report shows price pressures are still broad. That environment keeps energy costs and interest rates in every conversation, and investors who want exposure to companies tied to real assets are watching closely. This article walks through three large oil and gas stocks from the global majors and explains what each brings to a portfolio right now.
